headlines.title: 樊纲：房地产市场已出现较为快速的价格出清
headlines.summary: 8月12日上午，中国经济体制改革研究会副会长、国民经济研究所所长樊纲在2026年博鳌房地产论坛上发表经济演讲。樊纲表示，中国经济正经历一次更符合市场经济规律的结构性调整，房地产市场已出现较为快速的价格出清，触底过程可能快于日本当年。从需求侧看，中国长期“重供给轻需求”的结构性问题正得到正视。樊纲指出，当前“十五五”规划已将市场需求视为最稀缺资源，宏观经济学本质上是需求决定论。消费观念也出现积极转变，年轻一代科技新贵开始注重居住品质，大城市豪宅成为市场销售主力，这标志着新经济增长逻辑的开启。“中国经济正处在一个更市场化、更符合规律的发展新阶段。”樊纲指出。

headlines.title_en: Fan Gang: property market has seen relatively rapid price clearing
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, Fan Gang, Vice President of the China Society of Economic Reform and Director of the National Economic Research Institute, delivered an economic speech at the 2026 Boao Real Estate Forum. Fan Gang stated that China's economy is undergoing a structural adjustment more in line with market economy laws, and the real estate market has seen a relatively rapid price clearing, with the bottoming process potentially faster than Japan's in its time. On the demand side, China's long-standing structural issue of "emphasizing supply over demand" is being addressed. Fan Gang noted that the current "15th Five-Year Plan" has identified market demand as the most scarce resource, and macroeconomics is essentially demand-determined. Consumption concepts are also shifting positively, with the young generation of tech elites focusing on living quality, and luxury homes in major cities becoming the main sales driver, marking the start of a new economic growth logic. "China's economy is in a new, more market-oriented and law-conforming stage of development," Fan Gang pointed out.

headlines.summary:

headlines.title: 美联储柯林斯：如果通胀依然高企，将支持9月加息
headlines.summary: 据英国金融时报报道，美联储柯林斯表示，由于伊朗战争加剧了生活成本压力，美国贫困人口正努力维持生计。她警告称，美联储可能需要提高利率以抑制通胀。柯林斯表示，美国东北部的企业和家庭正受到通胀的挤压，而通胀率已经超过央行2%的目标五年多了。她指出：“我几乎每次（和企业）谈话都会听到（价格方面的）问题。”她补充说：“在中低收入家庭中，我越来越听到他们面临的挑战……比如难以维持生计。能源价格确实令人难以承受，尤其是在我们这个地区。”柯林斯目前在FOMC中没有投票权，她支持7月份维持利率不变，并认为当前利率水平“略具紧缩性”，且“这将使其预期通胀率将逐步持续下降”。

headlines.title_en: Fed's Collins: if inflation remains high, would support a rate hike in September
headlines.summary_en: According to the Financial Times, Fed's Collins said that due to Iran war intensifying cost-of-living pressures, poor Americans are struggling to make ends meet. She warned the Fed may need to raise interest rates to curb inflation. Collins said businesses and households in the Northeast are squeezed by inflation, which has exceeded the central bank's 2% target for over five years. She noted: "I hear about it in almost every conversation (with businesses)." She added: "Among lower- and middle-income households, I increasingly hear about their challenges... like difficulty making ends meet. Energy prices are truly unaffordable, especially in our region." Collins currently has no vote on the FOMC, supported holding rates steady in July, and believes current rates are "somewhat restrictive," which "would lead inflation to gradually and sustainably decline."

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).
Since launching the disposal plan with JLL in July last year, the chain had sold 11 properties for more than HK$900 million –...
headlines.title_zh: 在香港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳的资产有何独特优势？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近一半物业找到买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合最初估值约为30亿港元（合3亿美元）。

headlines.title_en: August 12 midday close review: ChiNext Index up 1.73% in half-day, computing hardware stocks collectively strengthened
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets oscillated higher in morning trade, with ChiNext and STAR indices leading gains. Computing hardware stocks collectively surged, with JuGuang Technology, Yongding Co., Tongding Interconnection and others hitting limit up. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied, Xiandao Jidian up on 3 boards in 4 days, Zhichun Technology hit limit up. Innovative drug concept remained active, Baihua Medicine up 7 consecutive boards, Zhejiang Medicine and Yuhuan Pharmaceutical hit limit up. On the downside, oil and coal sectors fell, Xindazhou A and Shouhua Gas down over 5%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,600 stocks in the red across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, with morning turnover of 1.39 trillion yuan. At midday close, Shanghai Composite up 0.32%, Shenzhen Component up 1.25%, ChiNext up 1.73%. 2. headlines.title: 面壁智能启动IPO
headlines.summary: 证监会网站披露，北京面壁智能科技股份有限公司于2026年8月11日在北京证监局办理辅导备案登记，拟首次公开发行股票并上市，辅导券商为中信证券。辅导备案报告显示，该公司无控股股东，公司第一大股东为北京清语启航科技中心（有限合伙），持股比例16.45%。

headlines.title_en: Mianbi Intelligence launched IPO
headlines.summary_en: CSRC website disclosed that Beijing Mianbi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. filed for tutoring registration with the Beijing CSRC bureau on August 11, 2026, planning an IPO, with CITIC Securities as sponsoring broker. The tutoring filing report shows the company has no controlling shareholder, with its largest shareholder being Beijing Qingyu Qihang Technology Center (Limited Partnership), holding 16.45%.

headlines.title: 煤炭工业五年规划发布！下半年煤炭板块普涨（附绩优股）
headlines.summary: 8月12日上午，中国经济体制改革研究会副会长、国民经济研究所所长樊纲在2026年博鳌房地产论坛上发表经济演讲。樊纲表示，中国经济正经历一次更符合市场经济规律的结构性调整，房地产市场已出现较为快速的价格出清，触底过程可能快于日本当年。从需求侧看，中国长期“重供给轻需求”的结构性问题正得到正视。樊纲指出，当前“十五五”规划已将市场需求视为最稀缺资源，宏观经济学本质上是需求决定论。消费观念也出现积极转变，年轻一代科技新贵开始注重居住品质，大城市豪宅成为市场销售主力，这标志着新经济增长逻辑的开启。“中国经济正处在一个更市场化、更符合规律的发展新阶段。”樊纲指出。
